## Product

The one thing a business buys, sells or stocks, identified by its SKU: `sku`, `productName` and `productType` (`inventory`, `non-inventory` or `service`). Domain cards extend it rather than defining their own product, so every domain links to the same card.

```ts
import { Product } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/commerce/product';

@field product = linksTo(Product);
```

Extended by fulfilment's `FulfilmentProduct`, which adds what you need to move an item (barcode, parcel size, supplier), and by the accounting `Item`, which adds the ledger accounts an inventory item posts to. A subclass overriding a format keeps its own template; the base formats are typed `BaseDefComponent` so overrides stay assignable.

### Non-goals
No price, cost or stock level: those depend on the domain (a price list, a ledger, a warehouse) and live on the cards that extend or link to Product.

### Example
`Product/ceramic-mug`, an inventory item.
